ConnectionStrings._comment: ConnectionStrings:IdentityDb is required. Set ConnectionStrings__IdentityDb env var or add to configuration.
ConnectionStrings._redisComment: Set ConnectionStrings__Redis (e.g. redis:6379) for distributed lockout across Identity instances. When empty, InMemoryLockoutService is used (single-instance only).

Cors._comment: Production: Set explicit domain(s) in Cors:AllowedOrigins. Never use wildcard (*). Dev: localhost:3000, localhost:5173.
